log.text: Stealth Rock up on P1's side

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Scizor. Lead Politoed+Archaludon repeats the G1 rain core that dismantled sand instantly—Hydro Pump OHKOs Hippowdon/Excadrill, Draco Meteor threatens Blaziken-Mega for guaranteed KO at -1 SpD. Even if opponent brings Pikachu (LightningRod), Archaludon pivots to Draco Meteor/Aura Sphere. Backline Grimmsnarl provides critical Reflect vs Blaziken physical hits and Prankster support; Scizor-Mega's Technician Bullet Punch cleans up weakened targets late. Scizor only enters after Blazik
decisions.notebook: G2: Opponent down 0-1, must adapt. Available: Pikachu(LightBall/LightningRod/Jolly, FakeOut+ThunderWave) and Kingambit(BlackGlasses/SupremeOverlord/Adamant, SuckerPunch+1). Pikachu LightningRod hard-counters Archaludon Electro Shot—expect it if opponent adapts. Kingambit Close Combat 4x from both Scizor-Mega and Staraptor. Scizor-Mega never enters while Blaziken alive (4x Fire). Reflect critical every turn vs Blaziken physical hits. Politoed Hydro Pump OHKOs both sand mons. Rain from Drizzle overrides Sand Stream and weakens Flare Blitz. If opponent drops sand for Pikachu+Blaziken+Whimsicott+Kingambit, prioritize removing Blaziken first via Draco Meteor/Hydro Pump before bringing Scizor-Mega. Watch for Whimsicott Prankster Taunt outspeeding Grimmsnarl (149-184 vs 80 Spe).

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Blaziken, held as endgame cleaner. Lead Pikachu+Excadrill: Pikachu (156 Spe) Fake Outs Politoed before Grimmsnarl's Prankster Fake Out resolves, denying the T1 rain pump that OHKOs Excadrill, while LO Iron Head (95-180%) threatens Grimmsnarl before Reflect; Lightning Rod blanks Electro Shot. Hippowdon back flips rain to sand (slower setter), walls their physical side, and unlocks 308-Spe Sand Rush cleanup. Never EQ beside Pikachu/Blaziken.
decisions.notebook: Opponent (GLM) tendencies: opens Grimmsnarl+Politoed, Fake Out + Hydro Pump; preserves Grimmsnarl via switch for a second Fake Out on re-entry (Protect punishes); set Reflect LATE in G1 (Light Clay, 8 turns) — may open it earlier now; Scizor held Scizorite but didn't mega G1. Benchmarks: Modest Politoed Hydro Pump OHKOs Hippowdon/Excadrill/Blaziken — never leave them in vs it; Pikachu is the only real Politoed pressure (tool ignores Light Ball: double its Wild Charge output, ~89-167%; Sitrus can still save Politoed). Excadrill LO Iron Head = 95-180% vs Grimmsnarl (possible OHKO; getting flinched ruins it). Prankster Reflect is +1 priority — outruns every attack we have; with Whimsicott benched there is no Taunt, so Grimmsnarl must be KO'd T1-T2 or we fight through an 8-turn Reflect with an all-physical team (if it goes up, stall with Protect/Yawn, paralyze with TWave). Archaludon: Stamina on ANY hit — kill with ONE LO Excadrill EQ only; Blaziken CC ~84% and EBelt Modest Draco KOs Blaziken back; no Protect on Archaludon/Grimmsnarl; Electro Shot instant-charges only in rain; Lightning Rod redirects it. Kill Scizor early (Mega Blaziken 4x Flare Blitz from any HP) or Technician BP KOs Blaziken from full late. Sand Rush Excadrill (308) outspeeds Noivern + Scarf Staraptor; Hippowdon is the slower setter so sand wins simultaneous weather. Never EQ beside Pikachu/Blaziken; even Hippo takes it hard. CC drops make Blaziken Spirit Break-food — avoid CC while Grimmsnarl lives. HH Politoed + Scizor CC can OHKO Blaziken. G2 mode: Pikachu+Excadrill lead, Hippo+Mega Blaziken back.

decisions.rationale: Split targeting punishes single Protects and ensures at least one KO even if flinched: if they FO Politoed, Draco Meteor KOs Pikachu (60–243%); if they FO Archaludon, Hydro Pump can OHKO Excadrill (45–163%). Only loses to double Protect (neutral turn, rain still up). Draco Meteor SpA drop is acceptable—removing Pikachu eliminates Fake Out + LightningRod, freeing Electro Shot later. Wild Charge threatens 26–102% on Politoed, so removing Pikachu is urgent.
decisions.notebook: G2 T1: Opponent leads Pikachu(LightBall/LightningRod)+Excadrill(LifeOrb/SandRush inactive in rain). Excadrill EQ 31–93% on Archaludon but hits ally Pikachu 2x—opponent unlikely to EQ unless Pikachu Protects. Pikachu Wild Charge 26–102% on Politoed (Light Ball may push higher). Hydro Pump possible OHKO on Excadrill (45–163%, 80% acc). Draco Meteor possible OHKO on Pikachu (60–243%, 90% acc). Aura Sphere alone 29–98% on Excadrill—not reliable KO. Excadrill speed 118–154 vs Archaludon 123—Excadrill likely faster with minimal EVs. Plan: remove Pikachu first to disable Fake Out+LightningRod, then Archaludon Electro Shot becomes usable. Switch Archaludon out post-Draco Meteor to reset SpA drop. Grimmsnarl Reflect still needed before Blaziken enters. Scizor-Mega stays benched while Blaziken alive.

decisions.rationale: EQ cannot OHKO Archaludon (58-99% max), so attacking only procs Stamina and gets Excadrill killed by rain Hydro Pump (122-218%, guaranteed OHKO) or Aura Sphere. Instead Fake Out flinches Politoed — the only move that could OHKO Hippowdon on the pivot — while Excadrill switches to Hippowdon; Sand Stream immediately replaces rain, neutering Hydro Pump for the rest of the game. Hippo safely tanks Archaludon's lone hit (Aura 18-42%, Draco 44-100%, Leftovers). Worst case is a predictive Draco into Pi
decisions.notebook: Opponent (GLM) tendencies: G1 opened Grimmsnarl+Politoed (Fake Out+Hydro Pump), preserves Grimmsnarl for re-entry Fake Out, Reflect set LATE (Light Clay 8 turns) — may come earlier; G2 adapted: led Politoed+Archaludon. Scizor held Scizorite but didn't mega G1. Benchmarks: Modest Politoed rain Hydro Pump = guaranteed OHKO on Excadrill (122-218%) and OHKOs Hippo/Blaziken — never leave them in unprotected; even unboosted Hydro threatens Hippo. Pikachu is the only real Politoed pressure (tool ignores Light Ball: double Wild Charge output ~89-167%; Sitrus can still save). CORRECTED: LO Excadrill EQ does NOT OHKO Archaludon (58-99% max) — Stamina always procs, never attempt the one-shot; Archaludon Aura Sphere vs Hippo only 18-42%, EBelt Draco vs Hippo 44-100%; EBelt Modest Draco OHKOs Pikachu and Blaziken. No Protect on Archaludon/Grimmsnarl; Electro Shot instant-charges in rain but Lightning Rod redirects it (free, boosts Pikachu SpA). Sand Rush Excadrill (308) outspeeds Noivern + Scarf Staraptor; Hippo slower than Politoed so sand wins simultaneous weather, and a Hippo switch-in overwrites rain outright. Kill Scizor early (Mega Blaziken 4x Flare Blitz from any HP) or Technician BP KOs Blaziken late. Never EQ beside Pikachu/Blaziken (Blaziken 2x weak); even Hippo takes it hard. CC drops make Blaziken Spirit Break-food — avoid CC while Grimmsnarl lives; Prankster Reflect is +1 priority with no Taunt available, so Grimmsnarl must be KO'd within 2 turns of entry (if Reflect rises, stall via Protect/Yawn, paralyze with TWave). HH Politoed + Scizor CC can OHKO Blaziken. G2 mode: Pik

decisions.rationale: Excadrill is the perfect replacement: in sand it outspeeds their whole roster, blanks Electro Shot, and resists Archaludon's STABs at -2 SpA, while keeping Hippo's EQ available. Blaziken stacks a Draco weakness and Ground collateral, and loses to Noivern before a boost. Plan: Protect Excadrill + Hippo EQ next turn to chip Politoed and proc Stamina, then clean up.

decisions.rationale: Hydro Pump can OHKO Excadrill (77-146%, 80% acc) — the biggest threat. Rock Slide only does 17-29% to Politoed so flinch is survivable. Switching Archaludon to Grimmsnarl resets SpA -2 and brings Prankster; Grimmsnarl survives any spread hit on entry (12-63%). Next turn Fake Out flinches surviving Excadrill while Politoed finishes it. Opponent unlikely to EQ since it hits own Hippowdon.
decisions.notebook: G2 T2: Hydro Pump 77-146% on Excadrill (possible OHKO, 80% acc). Rock Slide 17-29% on Politoed, 12-35% on Grimmsnarl. Hippowdon EQ 21-63% on Grimmsnarl. Archaludon at SpA -2 switched to Grimmsnarl to reset. Plan: KO Excadrill this turn or next via Fake Out+Hydro Pump combo. Grimmsnarl Reflect needed before Blaziken enters. Scizor-Mega benched while Blaziken alive (EQ 2x on Scizor). Sand has 4 turns left; Excadrill SandRush active (236-308 speed). Opponent back: Blaziken (SpeedBoost/Blazikenite), Whimsicott (Prankster/Sash/Tailwind), Kingambit (SupremeOverlord/BlackGlasses).

decisions.rationale: EQ only ~4% to KO 76% Politoed (Sitrus), so attacking leaves Excadrill eating a 96-146% Hydro Pump. Protect scouts it while Yawn on Politoed's slot forces the switch or sleep, neutralizing the only OHKO threat and delaying rain reset. -2 Archaludon cannot meaningfully hurt Hippo (Aura Sphere ~18-42% at neutral, halved now). Next turn Excadrill acts freely vs a drowsy/switched Politoed with sand up.
decisions.notebook: Opponent (GLM): G1 opened Grimmsnarl+Politoed, preserves Grimmsnarl for re-entry Fake Out, Reflect set late (Light Clay); G2 led Politoed+Archaludon. Benchmarks: Modest Politoed Hydro Pump = OHKO on Excadrill even IN SAND (96-146%), OHKOs all in rain — never leave Excadrill unprotected vs it; Excadrill EQ only ~4% to KO 76% Politoed and Sitrus punishes the chip — answer Politoed via Yawn/sand chip/weather control, not direct damage. LO Excadrill EQ does NOT OHKO Archaludon (58-99%), Stamina always procs. Archaludon Aura Sphere vs Hippo 18-42%, EBelt Draco vs Hippo 44-100% (halve at -2); EBelt Modest Draco OHKOs Blaziken. Plan G2: Yawn-force Politoed out, chip Archaludon with EQ once Politoed is gone/asleep, Blaziken mega endgame vs Scizor/Grimmsnarl.

decisions.rationale: Switching Politoed clears Yawn (sleep is non-volatile — would lose Drizzle for 1-3 turns). Grimmsnarl Reflect gets Prankster +1 priority, landing before Excadrill's 0-priority attacks. Archaludon resists Iron Head 0.25x and Rock Slide 0.5x; even EQ is only 15-46% thru Reflect+spread. Hydro Pump's 20% miss + guaranteed sleep is too risky when up 1-0. Next turn: Aura Sphere 2x SE on Excadrill or bring Politoed back for rain to kill SandRush.
decisions.notebook:
Opponent core: Hippowdon (SandStream/Leftovers/Impish) sets sand + Yawn support; Excadrill (SandRush/LifeOrb/Jolly, 236-308 Spe under sand) Protects to block predicted hits. Back: Blaziken (SpeedBoost/Blazikenite/Jolly, 132-167 Mega Spe), Whimsicott (Prankster/Sash/Timid, Tailwind/Taunt/Encore), Kingambit (SupremeOverlord/BlackGlasses/Adamant, SuckerPunch priority).
Key tools: Politoed Drizzle overrides sand→rain, removing SandRush (Excadrill drops to 118-154 Spe). Archaludon Aura Sphere = 2x SE on Excadrill; Electro Shot immune (Ground). Grimmsnarl Fake Out fails after first turn on field. Prankster gives Reflect/LightScreen +1 priority.
Plan: Reflect up T3. T4: Archaludon Aura Sphere on Excadrill, or switch in Politoed for rain to neuter SandRush. Keep Reflect for Blaziken physical hits (CC 2x on Archaludon Steel becomes 1x thru Reflect). Mega Scizor only after Blaziken down or sand removed (EQ 2x on Scizor Steel). Whimsicott Sash + Prankster Tailwind is a speed threat; Grimmsnarl Prankster can mirror screens. Kingambit SuckerPunch priority — force Protect or switch before KO range.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Hydro Pump OHKOs Excadrill even in sand, so attacking Grimmsnarl risks losing my win condition for free. Protect (67% with reduction) blocks Hydro Pump/Fake Out; if Politoed stays, it sleeps end of turn. Stealth Rock breaks Noivern's Focus Sash and chips Archaludon on re-entry, paying no tempo since Hippo can't meaningfully hurt either foe. Next turn Excadrill acts freely vs a sleeping or switched Politoed.

Plan G2: Politoed sleeps or switches; next turn pressure Grimmsnarl with Iron Head, preserve Excadrill; Blaziken mega endgame vs Scizor/Grimmsnarl.

decisions.rationale: Archaludon at -2 SpA can't KO Excadrill (Aura Sphere ~21-49%) and barely survives double EQ through Reflect. Switching to Politoed sets rain via Drizzle, removing Excadrill's SandRush (236-308→118-154 Spe) even if Politoed faints, since rain persists 5 turns. Politoed takes neutral EQ through Reflect (~16-42% from Excadrill) starting at ~57.5% post-rocks. Grimmsnarl chips Hippowdon with Spirit Break and stays for Prankster screen support. Rain also weakens Blaziken's Fire moves later.
decisions.notebook:
Opponent core: Hippowdon (SandStream/Leftovers/Impish) sets sand + Yawn/Stealth Rock support; Excadrill (SandRush/LifeOrb/Jolly, 118-154 base Spe, 236-308 under sand) Protects to block predicted hits, double EQ with Hippowdon is main damage mode. Back: Blaziken (SpeedBoost/Blazikenite/Jolly, 132-167 Mega Spe), Whimsicott (Prankster/Sash/Timid, Tailwind/Taunt/Encore), Kingambit (SupremeOverlord/BlackGlasses/Adamant, SuckerPunch priority).
Key tools: Politoed Drizzle overrides sand→rain (5 turns, persists even if Politoed faints), removing SandRush. Archaludon Aura Sphere 2x SE on Excadrill but Electro Shot immune to Ground. Grimmsnarl Fake Out only works first turn on field. Prankster gives Reflect/LightScreen +1 priority. Reflect halves physical EQ damage.
Plan: T4 switch Archaludon→Politoed for rain to neuter SandRush. Next turn Politoed Hydro Pump on Excadrill (STAB+rain+2x SE on Ground). Keep Grimmsnarl for Prankster screens. Mega Scizor only after sand removed (EQ 2x on Steel). Whimsicott Sash+Prankster Tailwind is speed threat; Kingambit SuckerPunch priority — force Protect or switch before KO range. Blaziken Fire moves weakened by rain.

decisions.rationale: Protect is 100% this turn (last Protect failed, counter reset) and outprioritizes Fake Out, denying the flinch+Aura Sphere combo that removes my sand sweeper. Hippowdon is slowest on the field, so Yawn lands on slot-a regardless of a pivot: Archaludon must switch (SR chip) or sleep, and any switch-in gets Yawned too. Grimmsnarl alone can't threaten Excadrill; next turn Iron Head pressures it through Reflect while sand/Reflect tick down.

Scizor held Scizorite but didn't mega G1. Benchmarks: Modest Politoed Hydro Pump = OHKO on Excadrill even IN SAND — never leave Excadrill unprotected vs it; answer Politoed via Yawn/sand chip. EBelt Modest Aura Sphere vs Excadrill 52-89% (no OHKO even with Fake Out chip, but flinch wastes the turn); Aura Sphere vs Hippo 18-42%. Iron Head vs Grimmsnarl 95-180% pre-Reflect (~48-90% through Reflect, no OHKO). Protect (+4) beats Fake Out (+3). No Protect on Archaludon/Grimmsnarl. Sand Rush Excadrill (308) outspeeds Noivern + Scarf Staraptor. Hippo slower than Politoed so sand wins simultaneous weather; keep Hippo healthy as weather insurance. Hippo is slowest, so Yawn punishes pivots by landing on the switch-in. Kill Scizor early (Mega Blaziken 4x Flare Blitz) or Technician BP KOs Blaziken late. Never EQ beside Blaziken; Hippo EQ hits Excadrill 2x (Steel) — never EQ beside Excadrill either. CC drops make Blaziken Spirit Break-food — avoid CC while Grimmsnarl lives. Plan G2: Archaludon sleeps or pivots; pressure Grimmsnarl with Iron Head, preserve Excadrill; Blaziken mega endgame vs Scizor/Grimmsnarl.

decisions.rationale: Hydro Pump guaranteed OHKOs Excadrill (105-244%) — must take this before Politoed falls asleep from Yawn. 80% acc is the only risk. Grimmsnarl Spirit Break on Hippowdon chips it and keeps Prankster screens alive. Reflect halves Excadrill's Iron Head, so Grimmsnarl at 88% likely survives. Next turn switch Politoed out to cure sleep; rain persists 3 turns.

Protect (~50% after last turn's success, plus pump's 80% acc) is the only play that keeps Excadrill alive vs that line and costs nothing if Politoed pivots to cleanse Yawn. decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Both actives have sleep (Politoed slp, Grimmsnarl Yawn). Keeping both in risks double-sleep T7 = losing. Hydro Pump OHKOs Blaziken if Politoed wakes (1/3) but CC KOs Politoed at 58% regardless. Double switch cures both; Scizor in slot a absorbs same-slot CC neutrally; EQ is neutral on Scizor (Bug resists Ground) and 2x on Archaludon but halved by Reflect+spread. Next turn: two awake Pokémon vs Blaziken+Hippowdon with rain still active.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Excadrill fainted T5 (Hydro Pump). Pikachu fainted T1 (Draco Meteor crit). Opponent remaining: Blaziken (100%, Blazikenite, Speed Boost, Jolly, 132-167 Mega Spe) + Hippowdon (68%, SpA -2, Leftovers, Impish, 67-99 Spe). My remaining: Politoed (58%, asleep, Drizzle), Archaludon (100%, Expert Belt, Stamina, Modest, 123 Spe), Grimmsnarl (88%, Yawn pending, Light Clay, Prankster, Adamant, 80 Spe), Scizor (100%, Scizorite, Technician, Adamant, 85 Spe→95-127 Mega). Rain 3 turns left, Reflect 5 turns, SR on my side 2 turns. Politoed Hydro Pump guaranteed OHKO Blaziken in rain. Blaziken-Mega CC guaranteed KOs Politoed at 58%. EQ neutral on Scizor (Bug resists Ground). Plan: cure sleep via switches, bring Politoed back later with Drizzle to refresh rain and Hydro Pump Blaziken/Hippowdon. Scizor-Mega Bullet Punch priority valuable vs faster Blaziken. Avoid Archaludon in Blaziken's CC range (2x SE Fighting vs Steel). Whimsicott and Kingambit not brought G2.

decisions.rationale: Both foes are neutralized (Politoed slp, Grimmsnarl drowsy→likely pivot). Reflect halves all my physical chip and Sitrus undoes Politoed damage, so attacking is low-value; a Noivern/Staraptor switch-in OHKOes Blaziken if I commit. Mega+Protect scouts their 4th, blocks Fake Out/Hydro Pump, and banks Speed Boost (167→250) to outspeed Noivern next turn (SR+Rock Slide KOs it). Slack Off keeps Hippo healthy as post-rain sand insurance.
decisions.notebook: Opponent (GLM): opens Grimmsnarl+Politoed or Politoed+Archaludon; preserves Grimmsnarl for re-entry Fake Out; pivots to cleanse Yawn drowsy; Light Clay Reflect behind pivots. G2: Politoed+Archaludon open, Grimmsnarl back; 4th unseen (Noivern/Scizor/Staraptor). Format: hazards/screens turn-limited (SR ~3, Reflect ~6 via Clay). Benchmarks: Modest Politoed rain Hydro Pump OHKOes Excadrill, Blaziken, Hippowdon — never leave anything unprotected vs awake Politoed. Noivern rain Hurricane OHKOes Blaziken; but SR(25%)+Mega Rock Slide KOs Noivern. Scarf Staraptor Brave Bird OHKOes Blaziken; Mega Blaziken 167, +1 boost=250 ties Scarf Staraptor, beats Noivern(157-192). Mega Flare Blitz KOs Scizor even in rain (4x). CC vs Archaludon through Reflect ~58% (no KO). LO Excadrill EQ no KO on Archaludon; Stamina always procs. Protect(+4) beats Fake Out(+3). Hippo slower than Politoed so sand wins simultaneous weather; keep Hippo healthy as weather insurance. Never EQ beside Blaziken. Avoid CC while Grimmsnarl lives (def drops→Spirit Break KO). Plan: stall Reflect/rain with Protect+Slack Off, then Mega Blaziken sweeps; re-set sand via Hippo when rain lapses.

decisions.rationale: Reflect halves physical hits, so Grimmsnarl survives CC on switch-in. Scizor Protects+Mega Evolves for free. Next turn Grimmsnarl Fake Out (+3 pri) flinches Blaziken while Scizor-Mega Bullet Punches. Archaludon is in CC KO range (83-138%) so switching it out preserves our win con.
